sources.title: Vision Language Action Models in Robotic Manipulation: A Systematic Review
sources.snippet: Abstract Vision Language Action (VLA) models represent a transformative shift in robotics, with the aim of unifying visual perception, natural language understanding, and embodied control within a single learning framework. This review presents a comprehensive and forward-looking synthesis of the VLA paradigm, with a particular emphasis on robotic manipulation and instruction-driven autonomy ...

sources.title: Multimodal fusion with vision-language-action models for robotic ...
sources.snippet: Abstract Vision Language Action (VLA) models represent a new frontier in robotics by unifying perception, reasoning, and control within a single multimodal learning framework. By integrating visual, linguistic, and action modalities, they enable multimodal fusion systems designed for instruction-driven manipulation and generalist autonomy.
